texts.zh: 既然[phaseshift_planet.GetName]已经在我们的领地之内，我们应该调查稳定该星球维度波动的可能性。如果我们希望在那颗宝贵的盖亚星球上殖民，我们必须设法阻止[phaseshift_planet.GetName]每隔三个月就变为虚境星球。
texts.en: Now that [phaseshift_planet.GetName] is within our borders, we should investigate the possibility of stabilizing the planet's state of dimensional flux. If we wish to inhabit the glittering Gaia World, we will have to devise a method of preventing [phaseshift_planet.GetName] from phase-shifting back into Shrouded World every three months.

texts.zh:
我们在[phaseshift_planet.GetStarName]星系内新获得的星球[phaseshift_planet.GetName]展现出了一些非同寻常的特性。它被一种只能称之为灵能的能源所包围，[phaseshift_planet.GetName]每单位空间内的量子叠加态数量，超出了至今为止被认为是可能数量的上限。

每隔三个月，叠加态数量就会达到临界值，使[phaseshift_planet.GetName]经历一次彻底的维度相位转移，它的粒子场将会旋转进另一个维度。该旋转会将一个虚境星球从另一维度转移至我们的维度，然后在下一个周期结束时再次将一个盖亚星球转移回来。

如果我们希望在那颗宝贵的盖亚星球上殖民，我们必须设法阻止[phaseshift_planet.GetName]每隔三个月就变为虚境星球。
texts.en:
Our newly acquired planet [phaseshift_planet.GetName] in the [phaseshift_planet.GetStarName] system exhibits some incredible properties. Occluded by a strange envelope of what can only be described as psionic energy, [phaseshift_planet.GetName] possesses a hitherto thought impossible number of superimposed quantum states per unit of space.

Every three months, the number of states reaches a critical level, and [phaseshift_planet.GetName] experiences a complete dimensional phase shift, its particle fields rotating out of one dimension and into another. This rotation phases a Shrouded World from another dimension into ours, only to phase back a Gaia World at the end of the next period.

If we wish to inhabit the glittering Gaia World, we will have to devise a method of preventing [phaseshift_planet.GetName] from shifting back into Shrouded World every three months.

label.zh: 那就想办法来相位锁定那颗星球吧。
label.en: Then let us find a way to phase-lock the planet.

label.zh: 我们还有更重要的事要处理。
label.en: We have more important matters to focus on.

texts.zh:
[phaseshift_planet.GetName]，一颗[phaseshift_planet.GetStarName]星系内的行星，近日被观察到正以三个月为周期，在虚境星球与盖亚星球状态间循环。

我们的物理学家应该可以开发出相应的办法，将其锁定在其中一种状态之中，使之永久处于盖亚星球状态，不再变回另一种状态。
texts.en:
[phaseshift_planet.GetName], a planet in the [phaseshift_planet.GetStarName] System has been observed to phase-shift between a Shrouded World and Gaia World on a three month cycle.

Our physicists should be able to devise a way to lock the planet in one of its states, freezing it as a Gaia World, and preventing it from shifting back.

texts.zh:
在六个月的繁杂计算，理论推敲，以及激烈争论之后，[Root.GetName]船员设计了一个方案，可将星球的粒子场锁定在一个正常状态，阻止其在两个维度之间旋转。

一道足够调谐的能源应该可以将[phaseshift_planet.GetName]固定为一个状态，将其锁定为一颗稳定的盖亚星球。
texts.en:
Following six months of number-crunching, theory-busting, and heated debate, the [Root.GetName] crew has devised a method by which the planet's particle fields can be locked into a nominal state, preventing their rotation between dimensions.

A sufficiently tuned pulse of energy should freeze [phaseshift_planet.GetName] in one state, locking it into a stable form as a Gaia World.

tooltips.en: [phaseshift_planet.GetName] will be permanently transformed into a Gaia World.
